review_description: Scott at Solar Power Panels was one 10+ quotes I obtained for my system. He is professional, communicative and informative. A conversation with him was enough to make me feel confident that I've found the right person for the job. He was able to tailor a suitable system with the features I was looking for while offering it at a competitive price. He also seemed thoughtful in figuring out the right system for me, providing me with valuable industry insights to anticipate any issues, potential shortfalls and realistic expected performance of the system. The other reviews I read from previous customers only further solidified my decision to proceed with this company.The installers were also punctual and friendly. Installation took approximately 5.5 hours and they gladly answered any questions I had on the day and ensured I was comfortable with how the system runs.I'd readily recommend Scott to any friends and family who are looking to install solar panels and batteries as I know they'll be in good hands.
From start to finish we received great communication with Scott and a quality job from Jacob and the crew installing. Was a pleasure doing business together.

Installation went perfectly and within the timeframe advised. The guys that installed were polite, fast, clean, and fun to have at my property doing the job.Scott, who I had been dealing with through the quotation process was wonderful and very knowledgeable. He was able to keep tuning and adjusting my quote as I changed which brand panels and inverter I wanted. He was also happy to have a random chat about genera solar stuff. He just loves solar! :)For value for money, I’m very very happy with the service and product I got. For anyone on a budget, I would highly recommend Scott and the team to provide a great upper middle setup at very competitive pricing.100% happy customer.
Scott was great to deal with not pushy at all - and gave some alter options on system sizes.Installation was arranged very quickly and the team were professional and communicated effectively

I recently had a system installed by Solar Power Panels. From the first contact, Scott provided exceptional customer service by patiently answering all my questions and guiding me through multiple different quote options. He took the time to explain the differences and benefits, ensuring that I made an informed decision. I ended up settling on 10kw of Jinko panels with an 8kw SunGrow invertor and smart meter. The price was very competitive compared to other quotes I received.Installation was scheduled for the next week, Jacob, the installer, demonstrated his professionalism and punctuality by arriving on time for the installation. All went smoothly with the setup and handover. I climbed up on the roof after and was impressed with the level of precision and neatness in his work.After the installation, both Scott and Jacob continued to provide outstanding support. They addressed any follow-up questions I had regarding the operation of the app, demonstrating their commitment to customer satisfaction. Overall, my experience with solar power panels was great. Thanks!

No muck around with these guys, and they know what they are doing, Scott was great to deal with, from the configuration of the panels on the roof to organizing the electrician. The installation was prompt, professional and spot on for a very hot day last week. Also did the connection paperwork. Big Big Thank you. Jinko Neo 415 panels pumping out a total of 58 kwh the first day from a 9.13 system, i am so happy i chose solar power panels.

Fortunately, whilst researching solar systems last year I came across a webpage from Solar Power Panels and decided to give them a call. It was the best decision in regards to solar I could of made. Scott answered my call, and after asking a few simple questions he designed a system that has since proved to be cost effective and extremely efficient. At no time during the sales process did I feel pressured. Scott was at all times polite, professional and informative. On the day of installation, the electricians and the installers arrived at the agreed time and fully completed the the job in under five hours. A few hours after the installation team had left, I received a follow up phone call from Scott to ensure I was happy with the installation process and asked if I had any further questions. I have been extremely happy with the immediate reduction in our electric bill from an average of $500 per quarter to an average of $30 per quarter since installing the 6.6kW system Scott suggested. My system has run without fail since installation last year, but the after sales service provided by Scott has been fantastic. Scott rang me once again a few weeks after install to check I was happy and the system. I am a genuine and extremely satisfied customer and would not hesitate to recommend the services of Solar Power Panels to anyone who may be seeking a quality solar system.
